Route 2 adds the range signature and matches the paper's sentence 'a four-point Likert scale (except items 5-7)': S1,S2,S3,S4,S8,S9,S10 all within 1-4, S5 10-20 (a sum over 5 family sources each 1-4), S6 1-5 and S7 3-7 (counts of endorsed sources).
